# Christian de Laszlo

> Training Architect for Deep Brain Stimulation. Global Training & Education
> Development Lead at Medtronic Neuromodulation. Ten years building the bridge
> between breakthrough brain technology and the clinicians who use it worldwide.

Based in Little Silver, New Jersey, US. Contact: christian.delaszlo@gmail.com

Key facts (all detailed on the pages below):

- Training lead for five major DBS platform launches: Percept PC (2020, the
  first DBS system able to sense brain signals), SenSight (2021), Percept RC
  (2024), Adaptive DBS (2025, the largest commercial brain-computer interface
  launch in history — one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2025), and Electrode
  Identifier (2025).
- Trained 70%+ of the current US DBS sales force; 2,000+ healthcare
  professionals certified globally.
- Inventor on 9 patented automation tools (6 as lead inventor), including
  Automated Calibration of LFP Sensing Tools (EP4633448A1) and Bipolar/Unipolar
  Stimulation Conversion (WO2024025913A1).
- Led the BrainSense Virtual Patient simulator (5–10× ROI).
- Primary subject-matter expert for Medical Safety on programming, BrainSense,
  Adaptive DBS, and surgical procedures.
- Recognized voice on where AI fits in neuromodulation.
- Education: Cornell University, B.S. Human Biology, Health & Society (2013).
